PaymentService/Authorize.no3ds_fail_payment: the Authipay/AIB sandbox approves every card transaction it is given — 500100 EUR, an expired expiry year and the shared 4000000000000002 decline card all return HTTP 200 transactionResult APPROVED — so there is no decline trigger to assert against. Same limitation as fiserv, which is the same gateway. The 200-with-decline mapping is covered by the unit tests in authipay/transformers.rs instead.
